dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin pumping while AVAX eats dirt  
Wassies NFT mooning, ZachXBT's got a mil  
Bitcoin's bearish wedge screams oops  
Crypto Twitter's wild, HODL or bust  
Elon winks, Vitalik thinks, we just vibe

Meme coins mooning while your bags bleed?  
Little Pepe's building empires,  
Dogecoin's just a tired joke.  
Vitalik's preaching, Elon's teasing,  
yet 76% of shilled tokens are dead.  
Jump on BONK or get rekt, degens.  
Crypto's wild, HODL or bust.
